server_description: Read the signed-in user's own Outlook mail through Work IQ, read-only: what colleagues have written about an order, such as the cause of a hold, planned dates and what the customer needs. Call fetch once, with entityUrls holding exactly this one path for the order number: /me/messages?$search="<order number>"&$select=subject,from,receivedDateTime,webLink,body&$top=10 Never fetch another path, and never ask it to send, reply, schedule or change anything. For each message use its subject, its sender, the date its content states and its webLink. Date each fact by the date the content states, such as the day documents were filed, rather than the received time. Mail is what people reported, planned or asked, never current status, and its internal details stay out of customer drafts.
